items.title: Dealer positive-gamma THICKENS and the pin band MIGRATES UP toward spot while front IV RICHENS on a FROZEN completed-bar frontier (2026-08-04 unchanged) under a calm, unchanged VIX band: from the prior after-hours 2026-08-04 read to this pre-market 2026-08-05 re-read on the SAME completed 2026-08-04 daily bar, SPY signed net GEX more than doubles (+1.357B → +3.090B), the gamma flip migrates UP 758.41 → 769.83 and the put wall lifts 755 → 772 (compressing the 772/775 pin band toward spot 774.22), yet the front expected move WIDENS and atmIV RICHENS (±7.96 → ±8.92, 27.84% → 31.13%) rather than easing — all while the completed-bar frontier stays at 2026-08-04, the VIX band is unchanged and calm (16.5, score 0), breadth holds broad (62.16%) and SPY sits at the 52-week high.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior participation-vs-sizing axis, which was measured ACROSS a one-bar frontier ADVANCE (2026-08-03 → 2026-08-04); this axis is the opposite — an intraday micro-structure shift on a FROZEN frontier (2026-08-04 unchanged) seen from a pre-market vantage where NO new completed bar exists. It is also distinct from a plain gamma-band-migration / pin-widening axis: here positive gamma THICKENS (net GEX more than doubles) at the SAME TIME the front expected move widens and atmIV richens and the pin band COMPRESSES upward toward spot — the reverse of the usual thinning-gamma / richening-IV pairing, where a richer front vol accompanies FALLING net GEX. Emit only when the completed-bar frontier is UNCHANGED (no advance) AND signed net GEX rises materially (roughly doubles, sign stays positive) AND the flip and put wall both migrate UP toward spot with the call wall held AND atmIV / front expected move richen — so a quiet re-read that leaves gamma, the walls or front vol unchanged does not trip the flag.
items.method: Add a 'gamma-thickens-with-IV-richening-on-frozen-frontier' composite test that compares the prior-window options/gamma read to the current read while asserting the completed-bar frontier is UNCHANGED (dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate holds 2026-08-04 with freshSymbolCount==symbolCount, carriedSymbolCount==0, missingSymbolCount==0, and the swing bar count static at 508). Assert FIVE joint conditions: (1) FROZEN FRONTIER — expectedSessionDate unchanged versus the prior window and swing bars static (508 → 508); (2) GAMMA THICKENS — signedNetGEX rises materially (1.357B → 3.090B, ~+128%) with the sign staying positive; (3) PIN BAND MIGRATES UP — the flip rises (758.41 → 769.83) and the put wall lifts (755 → 772) toward spot (774.22) while the call wall is held (775); (4) FRONT VOL RICHENS — atmIV rises (27.84% → 31.13%) and the front expected move widens (±7.96 → ±8.92); (5) CALM-IMPLIED / STABLE-CONTEXT GUARD — the VIX band is unchanged and calm (16.5, score 0), breadth holds broad (62.16%, threshold 60) and SPY is at the 52-week high (pctFrom52wHigh 0, bull-stack). Emit only when (1) AND (2) AND (3) AND (4) AND (5) all hold; the divergence is (2)+(3) thickening/upward-compressing gamma occurring together with (4) richening front vol.
